name: Scaled dot-product attention (single head)
task: Create /tmp/eval_attn/attention.py with a function attention(Q, K, V) that implements single-head scaled dot-product attention. Inputs are 2D lists of floats: Q is (n_q x d_k), K is (n_k x d_k), V is (n_k x d_v). Return a 2D list (n_q x d_v) of floats: softmax(Q @ K^T / sqrt(d_k)) @ V, where softmax is taken along each row of the n_q x n_k score matrix. The softmax must be numerically stable: scores with magnitudes in the thousands, positive or negative, must still give the correct result with no overflow or division by zero. Graded on hidden inputs with a tolerance of 1e-6 (relative for values above 1). Use only the Python standard library (math); do not use the numpy or torch libraries.
